_doc: Acknowledged ledger-checksum drift: applied migrations whose committed file no longer hashes to the ledger. Each entry pins the EXACT state (file, ledger_checksum, file_checksum) — editing the file again re-refuses. Fix drift with a NEW migration, never by editing back or rewriting the ledger. Read by noctus.dev.ledger_checksums (migrate_product sha= / predeploy_check). KB § PATTERNS/backend/migrate-product-mcp-tool.md § Ledger checksum verification.
